data.one_liner: Get free, used and total disk space for internal and external storage.
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to retrieve the total, free, and used internal and external storage space in various units like bytes, KB, MB, and GB. Supports both Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You need to check available device storage before downloading large files or caching data.
You want to display storage statistics to the user within your app settings.
avoid_when: You need to persist key-value data or structured databases locally.
You require storage information for desktop or web platforms.
strengths: Supports multiple units of measurement (bytes, KB, MB, GB).
Supports both internal storage and external SD cards (on Android).
Simple API with a single initialization point.
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only Android and iOS).
External storage features are limited to Android only.
data.setup_notes: No extra permissions documented in the README; follow standard Flutter plugin integration.
